description:
Covers the "Test your tool" panel: expanding a function, entering its
parameters, and running it.

Note: at the time this was written, clicking the panel's Test button
reliably resets the input fields but never populates the Output panel
(confirmed with a 60s wait and zero network activity on click) for a
tool that's only been saved via Update Tool rather than Published. So
this test verifies the interaction itself — expand, fill, run — and
captures whatever the Output panel shows, without asserting a specific
result. If/when that panel is confirmed to actually execute, an assert
on the output value should be added here.
